inputs.text: They’re presenting it as routine border policy, but the timing after Bill C-12 received royal assent on March 26, 2026, looks deliberate. The language about “strengthening” the system seems to be cover for a coordinated clampdown targeting Nigerians and others, while those who benefit remain out of sight.
